He also gives a very generous curve, he does want to see his students succeed.

text: Professor Vineet Bafna, Computer Science. He does not explain anything well at all. Graded exams and homeworks are returned extremely late. He appears to put little effort into teaching. He is a nice person, but his class is like a casual lunch seminar instead of something undergrads are actually being graded on. This is the class I have learned the least from in the bioinformatics series.
